name: The Dare
source:
On an ordinary, sunny day, the chirping of sparrows in the bushes - "I dare you, I dare you!!"

[From [url=http://teacup.lunaen.com/index.php?topic=291.0]The Teacup[/url]]
translation:
在一个平凡的、阳光明媚的日子里，灌木丛中传来麻雀的叽叽喳喳声——“我敢你，我敢你！！”

[来自[url=http://teacup.lunaen.com/index.php?topic=291.0]茶杯[/url]]
